laws.warrant: A located quantifier, connective or other operator contributes an operation, not an independent substantive denotation. The eight substantive coordinates record the word's own head (NSM_RESOLUTIONS §2, approved F144), so all eight are explicitly absent (F118), as for modifiers (row 3b) and predicates (F151-F152). Explicit projection convention; not a rule for every use of its spelling.
laws.positive: because, not, can, one and same as located prime readings: all eight substantive cells 0
laws.must_not: the substantive argument an operator takes (one of these people) writing PEOPLE into ONE

laws.warrant: The eight substantive coordinates record the word's own head (NSM_RESOLUTIONS §2, approved F144). A time or place head (NOW, HERE, BEFORE, ABOVE, FAR, INSIDE) denotes a time or a place, not a person or a thing: shouting it sends no one looking for an object (F057), and the chart groups the time and place primes apart from the substantives. All eight are therefore explicitly absent (F118), as for modifiers (row 3b) and predicates (F151-F152). The noun-like WHEN~TIME, WHERE~PLACE, SIDE and MOMENT fall under this guard because each of their heads is its own coordinate, outside the substantive bank. The guard is an authored head classification; no adapter may infer it from grammatical nounhood or part of speech (F159).
laws.positive: now and here as located prime readings: all eight substantive cells 0
laws.must_not: a time or place head class inferred from POS NOUN (afternoon, house); time or place typing writing WHEN into NOW or WHERE into HERE (families are metadata, F158 section 4)

laws.warrant: The eight substantive coordinates record the word's own head (NSM_RESOLUTIONS §2, approved F144). A substantive prime's head is exactly one of them and the other seven are explicitly absent (F118), as the approved feeling-noun contract writes SOMETHING +1 and the rest 0. The guard names prime profiles explicitly (F159): an ordinary substantive reading never triggers it, so part and body nouns (hand, wheel, handle), which may need PART alongside BODY or SOMETHING, stay open until their own contract is settled. A GSE head-record convention; the zeros alone do not satisfy F148's V/U/W test (F159).
laws.positive: I: I +1 and the other seven 0; SOMETHING: SOMETHING +1 and the other seven 0
laws.must_not: an ordinary substantive reading (box, hand) triggering it; WANT's experiencer writing SOMEONE into WANT; person typing writing SOMEONE +1 into I (F158 section 4)

native_predicate_rules.warrant: F144 option B: CAUSE is the word's own causative event, a causer's DO or HAPPEN bringing about a change in another participant. NSM writes that event as a doing followed by 'because of this, something happened to this someone else at the same time' (GW16, hit); the frames of cut, grind, dig, kick and kill and the outcomes of put, throw, push, make and build have the same shape, HAPPEN's undergoer frame (GW2014 Table 1.2). So VerbNet cause(...) writes CAUSE +1 only when the caused event asserts something happening to a participant other than the causer: a state or relation at its end or result, that participant's motion, transfer or emotional state during it, or its aspectual beginning or ending. A speech act's effect is only wanted ('this someone wanted something to happen because of it', GW2014 ch. 7), so say, tell, ask and talk get no CAUSE and no DO: their head is SAY. A typed Agent causer establishes DO; an event causer establishes HAPPEN; an unknown causer type establishes neither. A predicate refused as a wrong-sense or out-of-scope join never counts. BECAUSE is not an alias. When the native frame supplies participant declarations, the affected role must be declared there and must not be reflexive or an ownership-ambiguous body part. A generic Pred/result placeholder alone is construction data, not an asserted lexical outcome. A distinct role label alone does not establish a distinct participant.
native_predicate_rules.positive: kill (murder-42.1: not alive as the result), give (give-13.1: possession at the end), put (put-9.1: location at the end), build (build-26.1: existence as the result), frighten and amuse (amuse-31.1: the experiencer's emotional state), hit (hit-18.1, spank-18.3: contact at the end), throw (throw-17.1: the theme's motion), name (dub-29.3: designation as the result), start and end (begin-55.1, stop-55.4: the theme event begins or ends)
native_predicate_rules.must_not: say, tell, ask and talk (transfer_info only); seeing or knowing someone as something (characterize-29.2); learn and study (learn-14); focus (focus-87); continue (continue-55.3); hitting at something (hit-18.1: no contact); an emotional state refused as a wrong-sense join (interest, try and throw in amuse-31.1; matter in appeal-31.4)
native_predicate_rules.known_limits: A source frame without participant declarations retains the explicit scratch-frame contract used by mechanism tests. In source-bound frames, undeclared affected roles, reflexives, body-part ownership ambiguity and generic construction-result placeholders leave CAUSE unresolved; this abstention does not assert absence.

native_predicate_policy.source_polarity: A positive predicate asserts content. A negative unpaired predicate writes explicit absence 0. A negated bipolar pole only excludes that pole unless an exhaustive transition warrants the opposite.

transition_warrants.ALIVE: A positive start state and negative terminal state for the same event and participant establishes death.

native_predicate_policy.role_collision: UNRESOLVED_PROJECTION_SCOPE; keep participant/subevent bindings distinct, never cancel them, and do not infer a limitation of the basis from a projection failure
native_predicate_policy.inheritance: One class/frame annotation per origin, retaining all membership provenance; no independent-vote count
native_predicate_policy.implicit_role_marker: A leading ? marks an implicit realization of the same role variable; preserve original arguments and normalize identity for phase comparison
native_predicate_policy.lexical_component: For an unpaired lexical relation, a required positive instance in the class definition establishes component presence. A negative state for another participant or stage does not assert that the word definition lacks the relation. Keep all scoped positive and negative evidence.
native_predicate_policy.transition_pole: The reviewed vitality transition projects its result direction; do not apply endpoint selection indiscriminately to lexical relation content.

native_residual_rules.warrant: A lexical perception predicate fixes the function; USAS sound/sight fixes modality. A sound-related noun or an effector rating alone cannot imply HEAR. Generic perception with no uniquely located modality remains a typed local decision.
must_not: sight-30.2 class name alone => SEE (overhear is a counterexample)
a negative source tag automatically means the opposite lexical prime
native_residual_rules.coverage: PARTIAL; additional native fields and atomic grammar still apply

admission_contract.legacy: Seventeen recorded historical approvals are pinned in core.LEGACY_APPROVAL_CONTRACTS; edited contracts require v2 validation.
admission_contract.validated: ACTIVE lifecycle, reviewed authority and warrant, semantic contract SHA256, and executable positive/must-not witness nodes. Release gate executes the witnesses.
admission_contract.independence: Native source associations and builder-derived confirmations never grant lexical authority. Empirical mechanisms must be conditional.
admission_contract.exception: An independently sourced correction retracts one exact reading/rule/application; foundational constraints remain active.
